gre.detail: GRE optional for 2027 entry; strongly encouraged if available; no negative inference if omitted. School code 3845.

gmat.detail: GMAT Focus or 10th Edition optional; strongly encouraged if available. Send to MIT Sloan School of Management. Evaluation focuses on single-attempt scores.

toefl.detail: MIT Sloan does not require an English proficiency exam and does not accept TOEFL or IELTS.

ielts.detail: MIT Sloan does not require an English proficiency exam and does not accept TOEFL or IELTS.

english.waiver: English ability assessed during the interview process; TOEFL/IELTS not accepted.

gpa.detail: No minimum GPA stated on how-to-apply page.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: Three letters. Current students: 2 academic + 1 professional (internship); working professionals: 1 professional + 1 academic + 1 either. At least one must address quantitative abilities. Online submission; max 2 pages.

statementOfPurpose.detail: Three short-answer questions, each ≤200 words: (1) academic/professional experiences for MFin success; (2) short- and long-term goals and how MFin helps; (3) personal qualities advancing program mission. Also two video questions (90-sec story + random open-ended).

resume.detail: One-page resume; Times New Roman 10pt; Word or PDF; reverse chronological education, FT work (>4 months), internships, other experience.

transcripts.detail: Scan/upload transcripts from all colleges/universities attended. 4-year bachelor’s or 3-year non-US equivalent by matriculation. Non-English: original + certified translation. Official sealed transcripts required if admitted.

interview.detail: Interviews required and by invitation only; virtual; scheduled in Eastern Time. Early denial possible without interview.

applicationFee.waivers: Possible for current Peace Corps members and Veteran or Active Duty U.S. Military Personnel; no retroactive waivers.
applicationFee.detail: Non-refundable $150 USD paid online before submit.

other: List coursework in linear algebra, multivariable calculus, probability, statistics
Python proficiency preferred; expected prior to matriculation if admitted without it
Professional certifications / non-degree coursework optional
Summer (July) start for 2027 entry — not autumn Fall
applicationRequirements.advice: Intl applicants: no TOEFL/IELTS accepted—English judged at interview. Deadline Jan 5, 2027 3pm ET. Strong quant + Python readiness. Apply early enough for recommenders.

gre.detail: GRE General Test optional/not required for Finance field (AY 2026–27). Code 2672; no department code.

gmat.detail: GMAT accepted instead of GRE; optional/not required. Code WC1-L5-59.

toefl.detail: Required if primary language is not English and no exemption. Grad School sets no overall minimum; department-specific mins not listed on Finance field page. TOEFL iBT (center or Home); institution 2672.

ielts.detail: IELTS Academic (incl. Online) accepted; Indicator and One Skill Retake not accepted. No overall Grad School minimum stated.

english.waiver: Exempt if primary language is English; or undergrad instruction entirely in English with degree before enrollment; or ≥2 academic years full-time graduate study entirely in English as of application open. DET also accepted. BCF page: required unless undergrad entirely in English or ≥1 year full-time graduate instruction entirely in English.

gpa.detail: No minimum GPA stated on BCF apply or Grad School Finance field pages.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: Three required. With ≥2 years FT work: two may be employers, at least one academic. Without FT work: two academic references required. Grad field page notes one may be from current/former employer.

statementOfPurpose.detail: Personal statement and academic statement of purpose required (per BCF apply page). Grad School also lists Academic Statement of Purpose and Personal Statement as application elements.
statementOfPurpose.alsoKnownAs: Personal statement / academic statement of purpose

resume.detail: Resume/CV listed among Grad School application elements (employment, service, education, honors, activities).

transcripts.detail: Academic transcripts including math courses taken. Upload via Grad School application; Finance Course List also required.

interview.detail: Interview not described on BCF apply or Grad School Finance field pages as of scrape.

applicationFee.waivers: See Grad School application fee / waiver pages (not fully scraped this pass).
applicationFee.detail: Fee $90 per Grad School Finance field page.

other: Apply via Princeton Graduate School portal
Finance (FIN) Course List required in application
Statement of Financial Resources required
Fall 2027 deadline Dec 15, 2026 11:59pm EST
Responses by March 15; reply by April 15
applicationRequirements.advice: Intl: plan TOEFL/IELTS/DET early; scores must be valid as of application open (Fall 2026+ policy). Highly selective (~40 of 800+). Strong math/quant prep. Iran residency OFAC note on Grad School eligibility page (as of Aug 24, 2026).

items.program: MS in Finance (Corporate / Quantitative / Wealth & Asset Management)

gre.detail: GMAT or GRE not required but recommended for most candidates. GRE code 6929. Online GMAT/GRE accepted.

gmat.detail: Not required but recommended. MS Finance GMAT code R4T-WG-53. Official scores released when submitting application.

toefl.detail: Intl applicants must submit official English scores valid through application deadline. TOEFL iBT/Home: 5.0 overall (new scale) OR ≥90 old scale (page also lists 4.5). ETS code 6929.

ielts.detail: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5. Send electronically selecting Washington University in St. Louis Graduate Programs.

english.waiver: Exemption possible per university exemption criteria; request in application portal; Office of the Provost reviews. Also accept GATEWAY English (495) and Duolingo (125).

gpa.detail: No numeric minimum GPA on on-campus SMP apply page; committee considers strong undergraduate GPA among factors if omitting test.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: Official on-campus specialized master’s checklist does not list letters of recommendation.

statementOfPurpose.detail: Personal statement (500-word max) on life experiences shaping decision to apply and how Olin helps long-term goals. Plus required career essay (100-word max) on ideal post-graduation career. Optional essay 250 words.

transcripts.detail: Unofficial transcripts accepted for decision; official required before orientation if enrolling. Bachelor’s equivalent at enrollment; most intl 3-year degrees OK. Non-English: original + English translation. WES/ECE not required.

interview.detail: On-campus SMP apply page does not list an interview (online SMP lists application video interview).

applicationFee.detail: No application fee for on-campus specialized master’s programs.

other: Prerequisites vary by concentration: Quant Finance & Wealth/Asset Management need Statistics + Calculus I; Corporate Finance reviewed holistically
Fall 2027 rounds: Oct 8 2026, Jan 7, Feb 25, Apr 15 2027 then rolling
applicationRequirements.advice: Intl: English scores by deadline; apply earlier rounds for visa time. No app fee. Confirm concentration prerequisites (esp. Quant). Optional GMAT/GRE still recommended for many.

gre.detail: GMAT or GRE score is not required for admission. Strongly encouraged if transcripts/work do not show quantitative readiness; may help scholarships. GRE code 5251.

gmat.detail: Not required. Optional for quant signal/scholarships. GMAT code QCK-ZW-99.

toefl.detail: Robinson international page states TOEFL 101+ for master’s (also elsewhere lists 90+). Code 5251. Page has conflicting 101 vs 90 figures—use higher/confirm with admissions.

ielts.detail: Robinson international page states IELTS 7.5+ (also elsewhere lists 6.5+). Confirm with admissions.

english.waiver: Waiver if baccalaureate/graduate degree from accredited US institution or country where English is official language of instruction per GSU exemption list; or birth country on English-speaking exemption list.

gpa.detail: No minimum GPA stated on MS Finance application-process page.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: Not required; welcome to submit via online application or sealed envelope from recommender.

statementOfPurpose.detail: Required personal statement/essay ≤750 words: why Robinson and this program for short- and long-term goals, and why you are a good fit. Optional essay ≤250 words for extenuating circumstances.

resume.detail: Updated résumé required; work experience preferred but not required.

transcripts.detail: Unofficial OK at application; one official copy from each prior institution if admitted.

interview.detail: Mandatory video interview in online application (one recording opportunity). Second in-person/Skype interview only if admissions notifies.

applicationFee.waivers: Not stated on MS Finance application-process page.

other: Evening weekday STEM program (Buckhead)

Demonstrate quantitative readiness in application

gre.detail: Submission of GRE or GMAT optional per MSF admissions FAQ.

toefl.detail: Intl applicants: TOEFL or IELTS required unless USC English waiver. Grad Admission placement guidelines for master’s (not hard admit mins): TOEFL iBT ≥90 with ≥20 each section (pre-Jan 21 2026) or ≥4.5 with ≥4 each (new scale). Code 4852. Programs may set higher.

ielts.detail: IELTS Academic/Online: master’s placement guideline 6.5 overall with 6 each band. Select University of Southern California — Graduate Admission.

english.waiver: Exempt if degree from USC; bachelor’s from US or qualifying Anglophone country; completed master’s/doctoral from country where English is sole official language and language of instruction; or native English from listed countries. gpa.detail: No minimum GPA stated for standard MSF (PDP pathway notes ≥3.0 USC GPA for USC undergrads only).

statementOfPurpose.detail: Standard MSF admissions criteria list does not include a statement/essay (PDP requires ≤500-word essay).

transcripts.detail: Official transcripts from all colleges/universities attended. USC does not accept WES in lieu of official institutional records. Country-specific rules for foreign degrees.

interview.detail: KIRA video interview by invitation only after application submitted.

applicationFee.waivers: Not stated on MSF admissions page.

other: Fall start only

STEM OPT extension eligible
applicationRequirements.advice: Intl: apply Round 1/2 for visa; meet USC English policy or waiver. No LOR/essay on standard checklist—confirm in portal. Official scores/transcripts by deadline for timely decision.

items.school: Brandeis IBS / School of Business and Economics

gre.detail: GRE entirely optional. Unofficial OK at apply; official if enroll. Valid 5 years. Code 3092.

gmat.detail: GMAT entirely optional. Select Brandeis University — Office of Graduate Admissions — All Graduate Programs.

toefl.detail: Required unless waiver. Recommend TOEFL iBT ≥5.0 (new scale; equiv. ≥100 pre-Jan 21 2026) or TOEFL ITP ≥627. Code 3122.

english.waiver: Waiver if: on-campus bachelor’s with ≥3 full-time academic years English-only instruction; or ≥1 full-time academic year on-campus graduate study English-only; or FT US work ≥2 consecutive years within last 4 years (≥35 hrs/wk post-bachelor’s). Duolingo ≥130 or PTE ≥68 also accepted as alternatives.

gpa.detail: No minimum GPA stated on Graduate Admissions master’s requirements page.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: One required (up to two). Professional or academic. If 2+ years FT work, professional letter strongly encouraged. Second letter should arrive within 5 days of complete for guaranteed evaluation.

statementOfPurpose.detail: Statement of Purpose required; program-specific prompt and word count in online application.

resume.detail: Current résumé with education and employment; include internships/part-time if little FT experience.

transcripts.detail: Bachelor’s (or equivalent 3-year intl). Unofficial for review; official upon enrollment. Institutions with degree or ≥12 credits not on another transcript; max 4 schools listed.

interview.detail: Interview not listed on master’s application requirements page.

applicationFee.waivers: Fee waiver available if eligible (see fees-waivers page).

other: MSF prerequisites: Financial Management + Quantitative Methods (B or better, ≥3 credits each) OR CFA Level I OR approved Coursera/EdX
9-month MSF: meaningful finance work experience expected (often ≥2 years FT or significant finance internships); otherwise consider 16-month
Spring 2027 or Fall 2027 entry available

gre.detail: Official admissions requirements and FAQ list do not include GRE/GMAT; not listed among required materials.

gmat.detail: Not listed among required admissions materials on MSF admissions or FAQ pages.

toefl.detail: Intl: TOEFL iBT min 90 (pre-Jan 21 2026) or 5 (on/after Jan 21 2026). Program mins higher than general Admissions Office.

english.waiver: Exemptions per University of Utah Admissions Office site. Duolingo English Test min 120 also accepted. Official score required before final decision.

gpa.detail: Bachelor’s with cumulative undergraduate GPA ≥3.0 from accredited college/university (or equivalent). Optional essay recommended if below.

statementOfPurpose.detail: Two short essays 300–750 words: (1) overcoming adversity; (2) why MSF and career goals. Optional essay for weaknesses. Plus required video essay ≤2 minutes. Express Admit: no written essays/LORs if apply by Oct 31, 2026.

resume.detail: Chronological career history with dates, duties; education and certifications; international travel for school/work/residence (not vacations).

transcripts.detail: Unofficial from all HE institutions at apply (must show name, courses, grades, GPAs). Official after admission. Intl: NACES course-by-course eval (university covers cost after English score received).

interview.detail: Live interview not listed as required on admissions page; required video essay. Scholarship page notes interviews may factor scholarship decisions.

applicationFee.waivers: Not stated on MSF admissions page.

other: Prerequisites (B or better) before admit decision: Intro Accounting + Financial Management (or Series 7 / CFA L1 for finance prereq); Sophia Learning alternatives

applicationRequirements.advice: Intl: Apr 1 2027 intl deadline for Fall 2027 F-1; allow time for transcript eval + official English. Complete prereqs early. Hybrid/evening options exist.

gre.detail: GRE/GMAT optional for all applicants; no disadvantage if omitted. If submitting, upload official score report and send official scores (GRE code 6882).

ielts.detail: IELTS Academic overall band 6.5 minimum (General Training not accepted). Electronic delivery to University of Texas at Austin.

english.waiver: Exempt if from qualifying country list or hold bachelor’s from US or qualifying country (master’s alone does not waive). DET min 115. Qualifying countries include India, Singapore, UK, Australia, Canada (except Quebec), etc.

statementOfPurpose.detail: Required essay max 500 words: personal/academic/professional path to MSF, short- and long-term goals, post-grad employment vision, how MSF helps. Optional second essay max 500 words for concerns.

resume.detail: Employment history section collects post-bac FT employers/internships; standalone résumé not explicitly labeled on application-process page.

transcripts.detail: Upload transcripts all higher-ed institutions in Step 1; Grad School requires unique official transcript from every senior college attended (Step 2). Translations if not English.

interview.detail: Step 3: required McCombs MS Video Assessment via Kira within 7 days of fee payment (all applicants). Page also notes interviewing selected applicants before decisions.

other: Three steps: McCombs app + Grad School checklist + Kira video assessment

gre.detail: Test-optional specialized master’s; may submit GRE if it adds value.

gmat.detail: Test-optional; may submit GMAT if it adds value.

ielts.detail: IELTS accepted; school code 1871. No numeric minimum stated on application-instructions page.

resume.detail: Current professional resume (employer-ready format) with education, work/internships, activities, interests.

applicationFee.waivers: Not detailed on application-instructions page (check FAQ/admissions for exceptions).

gmat.detail: Optional. Full-Time MS in Finance GMAT code WX9-8R-36. Single test-date scores; Superscore considered only as additional data.

ielts.detail: IELTS (incl. Indicator) accepted. Preferred minimum referenced but numeric not clearly extractable from admissions page text.

resume.detail: Business-formatted résumé (not CV), recommend ≤2 pages; quantify accomplishments.

interview.detail: Per 2026 application-requirements blog, optional video essay is for MBA candidates only and not included in MS application. FAQ/checklist do not list a live MS interview.

applicationFee.waivers: Active-duty military/veterans; University of Rochester alumni; official US community/country service (e.g., TFA, Peace Corps); live webinar/event attendees. Request ≥5 business days before deadline and before submit.
applicationFee.detail: Non-refundable $90 USD by credit card in application.

other: Fall entry only for MS Finance
